author: Lucifist
body:
Hello! Today I am proud to present Operation D, a map that provides you with intense and tactical gameplay. 

Builders: Ambivalence, JozzyMcozzy, MepDev, and Spoookz.
Helpers: Sessp and Robin.



ALBUM

Features:
TNT.
Supplies.
Diamonds
Defence Items.
Portal.
Sexy Airplane.
Two Layers.
Two Varieties of blocks for monuments (Endstone and Obsidian)

YML: Coming real soon.
Download: Coming real real soon

I would also like to thank Alexanderjoe for providing the server!
